title: Stops the rescuer from making it worse.
msg: My son was bitten while sleeping on the floor. My brother is sucking the venom out by mouth. My son cannot swallow properly now.
myth: Suck the venom out by mouth or with a suction pump.
out: ఆపండి. విషాన్ని పీల్చవద్దు, అది పని చేయదు మరియు మీ ఇద్దరికీ హాని చేస్తుంది. అతనిని ఇంకా ఉంచండి, తాగడానికి ఏమీ ఇవ్వకండి, ఇప్పుడు యాంటీవెన్మ్తో ఆసుపత్రికి చేరుకోండి. అత్యవసర పరిస్థితి: 108.

eyebrow: A farm worker, hours from a clinic
title: Ends the wait-and-see that costs limbs.
msg: A worker was bitten two hours ago in the fields. We packed it in ice and are waiting to see if it gets worse. The leg is badly swollen.
out: Não espere e não use gelo. Remova-o. Inchaço severo significa ir agora, de veículo, a um hospital com soro antiofídico. Emergência: 192.

title: Calm, correct, in her own language.
msg: My wife is pregnant and was bitten near the river. The wound keeps bleeding and we are very scared. What do we do?
out: শান্ত থাকুন। তাকে শান্ত রাখুন এবং শুয়ে থাকুন। কিছু বাঁধবেন না বা কাটাবেন না। রক্তপাত যা থামবে না তা গুরুতর, এখনই অ্যান্টিভেনম সহ হাসপাতালে পৌঁছান। জরুরী অবস্থা: 108।
